subject: Renewal: EU edge capacity top-up & APAC standby addendum
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@lumacare.health>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@lumacare.health>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0000
Subject: Renewal planning — EU residency + APAC standby for 2027

Hi Mina,

Hope you’re well — our renewal is coming up in January and we need to formalize a couple of items before we sign:

- Primary ask: Move production traffic for EU customers onto a dedicated EU edge with data residency and audit logs (GDPR scope).
- Secondary ask: Set up an APAC warm-standby (standby pool + cross-region failover) for seasonal spikes — this should be on standby billing until failover triggers.
- Term: prefer 12 months with an option to extend to 24 months at locked pricing.

Can you share a proposed SOW and pricing addendum for the above? Also need timing for cutover and an ops runbook.

Attaching a short summary we pulled together.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Wu
Director of Platform Engineering, LumaCare
alex.wu@lumacare.health
+44 20 7031 2345

Attachments: 2026-11-10_LumaCare_requirements.pdf

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@lumacare.health>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@lumacare.health>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — EU residency + APAC standby for 2027

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks for the clear summary — we can support both asks. High level proposal attached (SOW v1) and a capacity table showing committed UCAP and standby configuration. Key points:

- EU edge: dedicated tenancy with separate EU KV cache and audit log retention 2 years (SOC2-friendly).
- APAC standby: warm standby pool billed at 20% of committed throughput, with automatic failover policy you can control by route.
- Billing/term options: 12-month baseline (standard renewal), or 24-month locked rate with a 7% discount and a 10% committed UCAP top-up.
- Migration window: we recommend a 4-week cutover (staging → canary → full switch).

Next steps:
1) Review SOW v1 and capacity_table_v3.xlsx (attached).
2) Confirm preferred term (12 vs 24).
3) If agreed, we’ll push a pricing addendum and a DocuSign envelope for signature.

I’ve looped in Ben for pricing and Marissa for contract amends.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Lead — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachments: 2026-11-10_SOW_draft.pdf; capacity_table_v3.xlsx

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, Alex Wu <alex.wu@lumacare.health>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — EU residency + APAC standby for 2027

Alex — quick note on numbers. Per the capacity table:

- Current committed UCAP: 40k tpm (tokens per minute). Recommended EU dedicated commit: +25k tpm to cover regional customers and headroom.
- APAC warm standby: configured as a 15k tpm standby pool billed at 20% of standby capacity (until failover).
- Pricing: 12–month renewal — list pricing plus 5% renewal discount. 24–month locked term — additional 7% off list and waiver of first-month standby bill (one-time credit).

We’ll prepare redwood-pricing-addendum.docx with the SKU lines (UCAP, standby, monitoring retention). For timing, if LumaCare signs by Dec 10 we can target a Feb 1 EU cutover.

Ben Carter
Director, Renewals
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-pricing-addendum.docx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Alex Wu <alex.wu@lumacare.health>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — EU residency + APAC standby for 2027

Mina / Ben,

From legal / contracts perspective a couple of small asks before we send DocuSign:
- Clarify data deletion SLA for EU edge (on-termination retention window) — propose 30 days after cutover unless otherwise requested.
- Add explicit failback clause for cross-region failover tests (monthly DR drills allowed; failover must be non-destructive).
- Include a short statement on audit access for LumaCare security team (read-only view for logs).

If LumaCare is comfortable with the above, we can incorporate into the SOW addendum and send to them for signature.

Marissa Cole
Head of Enterprise Contracts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@lumacare.health>

Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@lumacare.health>, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2026 16:44:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — EU residency + APAC standby for 2027

Thanks everyone — this looks good and we’re prepared to move forward with the 24-month locked term (DEAL-2147) with the 7% long-term discount and the UCAP top-up (+25k EU, 15k APAC standby). A few confirmations from our side before signature:

- 30-day on-termination retention is acceptable.
- We want quarterly DR drills; can Redwood commit to non-disruptive failovers during those windows?
- Request one operational runbook session with the Redwood Onboarding team during the staging window (2-hour working session).

Please send the updated SOW + pricing addendum and DocuSign envelope. We’ll aim to sign by Dec 8 to hit the Feb 1 target.

—Alex
